utilities.name: Fecoergs, the federation of Rio Grande do Sul's electrification cooperatives
utilities.source: Fecoergs, Regulamento de Instalações Consumidoras – Fornecimento em Tensão Secundária (RIC BT), REGD 035.01.06, issued 10/05/2007, revision of 23/08/2024: Anexo J
utilities.rule: A and B (and A2 at 220/440 V) go by the installed load in kW; C, and B3 to B5 at 220/440 V, by the demand the designer works out by item 7.2, which the RIC asks for above 15 kW at 127/220 V and above 25 kW at 220/380 V.

changes.source: Coprel, Orientação Técnica OTD 006.01 'Orientações Técnicas para Fornecimento de Energia – Padrão C18', version 01, 24/09/2025, items 5 to 7: C18 may be measured directly, the current transformers left out

Cerfox, Informes técnicos 07-22 (16/08/2022) and 08-22 (18/08/2022), and OT_NIC_019 version 3.0 (30/07/2026), item 4: C18 stays measured indirectly; direct measurement only as an exception, asked of Cerfox beforehand with the load proven, for an installed load up to 75 kW, and never for a unit that only connects distributed generation

columns.connection: the connection branch, aluminium multiplex: D duplex, T triplex, Q quadruplex, and its section in mm²; C7 to C9, C22 and C23 are fed underground (note 9)
columns.entry_mm2: the entry branch, insulated copper, mm²
columns.earthing_mm2: the earthing conductor, insulated copper, mm²
columns.protective_mm2: the protective conductor, insulated copper, mm²
columns.entry_conduit_steel_mm: the entry branch's conduit, steel, nominal diameter in mm (light type I, NBR 5624, note 7)
columns.entry_conduit_pvc_mm: the entry branch's conduit, PVC, nominal diameter in mm
columns.earthing_conduit_pvc_mm: the earthing and protective conductors' conduit, PVC, nominal diameter in mm
columns.motor_cv: the largest motor or welding motor, cv: fn phase to neutral, ff phase to phase, fff three-phase (note 8)
columns.resistive_kw: the largest single resistive load (shower, boiler, electric tap), kW: fn phase to neutral, ff phase to phase (note 13); from C5 on the breaker limits it
columns.busbar_mm: the general busbar's least width x thickness, mm

tables.source: Anexo J, J.1 'Entrada de Serviço Individual' (page 68)
Anexo J, J.1 'Entrada de Serviço Individual' (page 68)
Anexo J, J.1 'Entrada de Serviço Individual', the two-phase rural network (page 68)
Anexo J, J.2 'Entrada de Serviço para Centro de Medição' (page 69)

notes: A breaker printed '30/32' or '63/70' may be either.
C18 is measured indirectly only (note 14), save where a member's own document says otherwise.
utilities.not_covered: the meter boxes and protection boxes (items 8.4 and 8.5), the poles and posts, and the demand of item 7.2 itself, which the designer works out

utilities.name: Hidropan (Panambi, Rio Grande do Sul)
utilities.source: Hidropan, Regulamento de Instalações Consumidoras – Fornecimento em Tensão Secundária, 5th edition, August 2014: Tabela 11
utilities.rule: A (single-phase) goes by the installed load up to 15 kW; C1 to C8 by the demand the designer works out (item 6.7.1), for an installed load up to 75 kW.

columns.connection: the connection branch, aluminium multiplex: D duplex, Q quadruplex, and its section in mm²; C7 and C8 are fed underground
columns.entry_mm2: the entry branch, copper (PVC 70 °C), mm²; the neutral as the phases (note 3)
columns.entry_conduit_steel_mm: the entry branch's conduit, steel, nominal diameter in mm
columns.earthing_conduit_pvc_mm: the earthing conductor's conduit, PVC, nominal diameter in mm
columns.motor_cv: the largest motor or welding motor, cv: fn phase to neutral, ff phase to phase, fff three-phase

notes: Tabela 11 prints C7 and C8 (82 to 115 kVA) under the same installed load of up to 75 kW as C1 to C6, as printed.
utilities.not_covered: the poles and posts (Tabelas 12 and 13), the breaker types of item 9 and the demand of item 6.7.1 itself, which the designer works out

utilities.name: Energisa, the group's distribution companies
utilities.source: Energisa, NDU 001 'Fornecimento de Energia Elétrica em Tensão Secundária a Edificações Individuais', version 7.0, November 2024: Tabelas 16 and 18
utilities.rule: M (single-phase) and B (two-phase) go by the installed load in kW; T (three-phase) by the demand in kVA the designer works out. The ranges take a power factor of 0.92 (note XII); a two-phase supply only above 8.8 kW at 127/220 V (note X).

columns.connection_multiplex_mm2: the connection branch, aluminium multiplex, phase section in mm²
columns.connection_concentric_mm2: the connection branch, aluminium concentric, mm², where the table allows it
columns.entry_pvc_mm2: the entry branch, copper PVC, phase and neutral in mm²
columns.entry_xlpe_mm2: the entry branch, copper XLPE, phase and neutral in mm²; 'XX(YY)' is XX embedded and YY underground (note 1)
columns.earthing_mm2: the earthing conductor, copper, mm²; 'A ou B' as the table prints either
columns.conduit_in: the entry conduit's nominal size, inches
columns.earth_rods: the earth electrodes: 1H one rod, 3H three rods

notes: A breaker printed '30/32' or '60/63' may be either.
Tabela 16 applies to EAC, EMR, EMS, EMT, ERO, ESE and ESS (note I).
The protection is sized at the top of each range; the breaker of the unit follows its own demand (notes IV and V).
utilities.not_covered: the building-entrance tables (collective units), the poles and posts, and the demand itself, which the designer works out

utilities.name: Equatorial, the group's distribution companies
utilities.source: Equatorial, NT.00001.EQTL 'Fornecimento de Energia Elétrica em Baixa Tensão', revision 09, approved 22/05/2025: Tabelas 1 and 2
utilities.rule: Every row goes by the installed load in kW, single-phase, two-phase (127/220 V only) or three-phase; the table prints no names, so a row is named here by the phases and breaker printed in its breaker column ('25 (MONO)' is 'MONO 25 A'). A range printed 'de 5,1 a 8' is taken from 5.

columns.connection_copper_concentric_mm2: the connection branch up to 2 km from the sea, copper concentric, mm²
columns.connection_copper_multiplex_mm2: the connection branch up to 2 km from the sea, copper multiplex, mm²
columns.connection_aluminium_multiplex_mm2: the connection branch from 2 km from the sea on, aluminium multiplex (duplex, triplex or quadruplex), mm²
columns.entry_conduit_steel_in: the entry conduit, galvanised steel, nominal size in inches
columns.entry_mm2: the customer's least insulated copper conductor, phase and neutral in mm² (note 26); 'X(Y)' is phase X and neutral Y
columns.earthing_mm2: the earthing conductor, copper-clad steel, mm²
columns.earthing_conduit_in: the earthing conductor's conduit, nominal size in inches

tables.source: Tabela 1 'Dimensionamento do Ramal de Conexão e Entrada das Instalações em 220/380V' (pages 29 and 30)
Tabela 2 'Dimensionamento do Ramal de Conexão e Entrada das Instalações em 127/220V' (pages 31 and 32)

notes: A consumer who takes a two-phase or three-phase connection below the single-phase limit pays the difference (notes 19 to 21).
The tables take a demand factor of 80 % and a 2 % voltage drop at the meter; power factor 1 single-phase and two-phase, 0.92 three-phase (note 23).
utilities.not_covered: Tabelas 11 and 12 that Nota Técnica 004/2026 adds for a unit fed by its own single-phase transformer (published 27/10/2026, binding from 24/02/2027), the collective units of NT.00004, and the poles and posts

utilities.name: Copel Distribuição (Paraná)
utilities.source: Copel, NTC 901100 'Fornecimento em Tensão Secundária de Distribuição', revision 01/07/2020: item 4.3 and Tabela 2
utilities.rule: A category goes by the maximum demand in kVA (Tabela 2), the designer's; each range runs from the category before it of the same phases. Categories 19, 22, 25, 46, 47 and 48 are the rural ones, single-phase three-wire at 127/254 V (the notes on page 34, and note 6 of Tabela 2).

columns.meter: the meter (note 8): M single-phase two-wire 127 V, M3 single-phase three-wire 240 V, B two-phase three-wire 127/220 V, T three-phase four-wire 127/220 V; Tabela 2 prints T for categories 46 to 48
columns.connection_mm2: the connection branch, multiplex, copper or aluminium, mm²
columns.entry_embedded_mm2: the entry branch embedded (method B1), copper, phase and neutral, PVC 70 °C or EPR/XLPE 90 °C, mm²
columns.entry_underground_mm2: the entry branch underground (method D), copper, phase and neutral, PVC 70 °C or EPR/XLPE 90 °C, mm²; categories 45 and 48 take EPR or XLPE only (note 11)
columns.entry_conduit: the entry conduit's nominal diameter, mm and inches
columns.earthing_mm2: the earthing conductor, copper, bare or covered, mm²
columns.earthing_conduit_pvc_mm: the earthing conductor's conduit, PVC, nominal diameter in mm
columns.pole_dan: the pole's load 200 mm from its top, daN

notes: Category 14 may take a 70 A single-pole breaker and category 38 a 70 A three-pole one (note 9); category 43's 150 A may be a 160 A (note 10).
The sections and conduits are the least (note 3); the neutral of the entry branch is as the phases (note 4).
utilities.not_covered: the motors of Tabela 1, the collective units of NTC 901110, and the demand itself, which the designer works out (Tabela 3)
